doc.description:
Acoustic orbit search with EARcam (fixed-wing, energy controller).
quiet_listen: low-throttle listening arcs. quiet_listen_on(thr) zeroes every energy-controller throttle term but nominal, sets nominal to thr and enables EARcam sampling (earcam_listen); quiet_listen_off() restores the saved gains. The request must be renewed every QUIET_LISTEN_HOLD_S and is dropped when the block changes; a GPS Abi callback and the always-false global exception quiet_listen_guard() enforce this in every mode. quiet_listen_session_hold() keeps the EARcam session open for the current block; leaving it by any route calls earcam_stop().
orbit_search: circle of ORBIT_SEARCH_RADIUS round a point, cycling ORBIT_SEARCH_QUIET_M of low-throttle descent and ORBIT_SEARCH_POWER_M of powered climb-back, each arc starting ORBIT_SEARCH_STEP_DEG further round. Flight plan: orbit_search_reset(WP_CENTER, WP_DROP), earcam_start(), then a block with pre_call="orbit_search_update(arcs, height, floor, listen_thr)" flying circle radius=ORBIT_SEARCH_RADIUS alt=orbit_search_alt(height, floor), left on orbit_search_done. See tudelft_include_imav2026_mission4_orbit.xml.
orbit_drop: run-in lane, climb-out and escape heights for the drop (ORBIT_DROP_*), the obstacle callbacks orbit_drop_obstacle (tree sectors M4_OW, M4_OE, M4_ON or outside the Geofence sector) and orbit_drop_outside_fence for earcam_place_run_in_lane and earcam_place_climbout, built only when the active flight plan has those sectors, and orbit_drop_hatch_close/open (COMMAND_HATCH).

define.name: QUIET_LISTEN_HOLD_S
define.description: listening request timeout

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_RADIUS
define.description: orbit radius

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_QUIET_M
define.description: distance of each listening arc

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_POWER_M
define.description: minimum powered climb-back between arcs

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_AIRSPEED
define.description: airspeed setpoint on the orbit

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_CRUISE_THR
define.description: nominal cruise throttle for the climb to orbit height

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_LISTEN_RADIUS_M
define.description: arcs only within this distance of the centre

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_MAX_S
define.description: listening ends at the latest after this time

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_STEP_DEG
define.description: start bearing shift per arc

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_START_WINDOW_DEG
define.description: an arc may start up to this far past its start bearing

define.name: ORBIT_SEARCH_REGAIN_TOL
define.description: climb-back tolerance before an arc starts

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_LANE_COURSE_DEG
define.description: run-in course over the target, from north

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_LANE_MAX_TILT_DEG
define.description: largest tilt of the run-in course tried

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_LANE_TILT_STEP_DEG
define.description: tilt step tried

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_RUN_IN_M
define.description: START distance before the target

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_LANE_MARGIN_M
define.description: corridor half width kept clear of the sectors

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_DROPTURN_SIDE
define.description: side of the base turn circle (+1 right)

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_CLIMBOUT_MAX_M
define.description: longest straight climb-out past the target

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_CLIMBOUT_MIN_M
define.description: shortest straight climb-out past the target

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_CLIMBOUT_RATE_MPS
define.description: climb-out rate

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_CLIMBOUT_AIRSPEED_MPS
define.description: climb-out airspeed

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_EXIT_TURN_RADIUS_M
define.description: exit circle radius

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_FENCE_MARGIN_M
define.description: exit circle distance inside the geofence

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_SAFE_HEIGHT_M
define.description: height above which nothing at the site can be hit

define.name: ORBIT_DROP_ESCAPE_HEIGHT_M
define.description: below this inside an obstacle sector: emergency climb
